body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Motorola Mobility had introduced its new Android smartphon 'ARTRIX' at CES 2011 held in Las Vegas.
(Picture: ARTRIX is connected to laptop dock)
It's true that newly released 'ARTIX' has not attracted big attention because of the concentration on 'XOOM', tablet PC with 'Honeycomb', the first platform for tablet PC of Google.

That also means Motorola Mobility is one of the enterprises which had prepared new and innovative product at this CES 2011. For example, it had unveiled extended products of 'ARTRIX' from dock type of alarm clock to laptop.
The release of 'ARTRIX' in Korea is confirmed and Korean early adapters might wait for 'ARTRIX' and Dock. Let's meet them first with video and pictures.
